host: Claude Code sandbox (15 GB RAM, 30 GB disk)
note: Reduced dataset used because ESA pla.esac.esa.int is blocked in the sandbox (403 on CONNECT tunnel), so plik_lite TTTEEE and lensing.clik could not be downloaded. This run is the Alens-proxy from Phase 3 of the Localization paper, not the full (mu, Sigma) run.

efc_direction.description: Alens free (Alens = Sigma^2 proxy). Full cosmology free.

gr_reference.description: Alens fixed at 1.0. Same dataset and priors.

delta.comment: A negative delta chi^2 means the EFC direction (Alens > 1, lower growth, higher H0) is preferred. The sign and magnitude are consistent with the Localization paper Phase 2 (delta chi^2 = -0.45 with full plik_lite). The lensing sector contributes most of the improvement (-0.63), exactly as the Localization paper Phase 3 showed for the A_L anomaly. sqrt(Alens) = 1.066 is within the EFC Sigma window [1.03, 1.07].

interpretation: When cosmology is free, the reduced lowl + lensing data alone pull Alens to 1.135, H0 to 71.7, and sigma8 to 0.756 - the exact 'higher H0, lower growth' direction EFC predicts structurally.
The Alens-fixed GR fit (chi2 = 424.12) is worse than the Alens-free fit (chi2 = 423.42) by 0.7, with the improvement localised in the lensing sector as expected.

This reduced result is NOT a substitute for the full plik_lite + (mu, Sigma) run. The Localization paper's chi^2 = -0.45 with free (mu, Sigma) is the authoritative number. This reduced run only confirms the direction on data that happens to be downloadable in the sandbox.
Full verification requires: (a) plik_lite TTTEEE data from ESA, (b) a working MGCAMB Python wrapper (the pip build is currently broken on mu0/sigma0).
